summary.title: LUKERN AS

narrative.text: LUKERN AS is a Norwegian private limited company in "Eiendomsforvaltning på oppdrag", registered 2013-07-22.
Registered activity: Eiendomsforvaltning og salg, og alt som hermed står i forbindelse, derunder deltagelse i andre selskaper.
Latest filed legal-entity accounts for 2025 show revenue of NOK 692,200 and an annual result of NOK 4.2 million.
Registered leadership: Frank Simon Smith (Daglig leder); Frank Simon Smith (Styrets leder).
Head office in Krokstadelva, with 1 registered workplace.
Not established from permitted exact-entity sources: brand, group, website, company profiles, jobs, public activity. This is not proof of absence.
